verdict.rationale: The product documents a short install path: `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init` to preview and write skill files for Codex and Claude Code. A keyless probe confirmed the version check and an init dry-run that previews SKILL.md targets in both harnesses. However, no evidence ties this to a single quickstart page or a five-minute timeline, only the dry-run (not the actual write) was observed, and the installed skill's hosted process functions refuse to work until a device-code login is approved by a human. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end quickstart with a time claim, a hands-on observation of the non-dry-run skill write, a working skill without login friction, and independent corroboration of time-to-first-success.
